authorisation: Organiser instruction: close the gap between the two supplied parcels and update every issued format. This is a competition-data topology revision, not cadastral certification.
method: Retain the exact existing union exterior, fill its two internal seam holes, retain Parcel A, assign the filled seam to Parcel B and remove the original overlap from Parcel B. No buffering or external outline movement.
projected_exchange_note: SHP/DXF are EPSG:32719 metre-coordinate chord representations of the WGS84 rings. The shared seam is re-reconciled in that CRS to remove millimetre-width projection self-intersections; symmetric-difference tolerance against directly projected WGS84 polygons is 20 m2. Scope and parcel union coincide and parcel overlap is zero within 0.01 m2 in the export CRS.
external_outline_reference: Exact union exterior of archived owner-supplied parcel coordinates. Previous scope file rounded intersection coordinates; numerical exterior difference is below 0.1 m.
legacy_submissions: Existing submissions are not rewritten; original boundary files remain archived. New generated outputs use this revision.
